executive_summary.en: Public discussion around MBG is concentrated on Food Quality, Budget Transparency, Food Safety. Negative sentiment is most associated with Budget Transparency, Food Safety.
executive_summary.id: Diskusi publik tentang MBG terkonsentrasi pada Kualitas Makanan, Transparansi Anggaran, Keamanan Pangan. Sentimen negatif paling terkait dengan Transparansi Anggaran, Keamanan Pangan.

description.en: Publish preparation standards, portion guidelines, and reporting channels so quality concerns can be raised and addressed.
description.id: Publikasikan standar penyajian, panduan porsi, dan kanal pelaporan agar keluhan kualitas dapat disampaikan dan ditindaklanjuti.

evidence.en: Food Quality appears in 21% of usable comments with 18% negative sentiment.
evidence.id: Kualitas Makanan muncul di 21% komentar dengan sentimen negatif 18%.

description.en: Provide simple explanations of budget allocation and oversight mechanisms to reduce uncertainty around program funding.
description.id: Berikan penjelasan sederhana tentang alokasi anggaran dan mekanisme pengawasan untuk mengurangi keraguan soal pendanaan program.

evidence.en: Budget Transparency appears in 8% of usable comments with 44% negative sentiment.
evidence.id: Transparansi Anggaran muncul di 8% komentar dengan sentimen negatif 44%.

description.en: Explain hygiene supervision, kitchen oversight, and how safety incidents are handled and reported.
description.id: Jelaskan pengawasan higiene, kontrol dapur, dan cara penanganan serta pelaporan insiden keamanan pangan.

evidence.en: Food Safety appears in 6% of usable comments with 38% negative sentiment.
evidence.id: Keamanan Pangan muncul di 6% komentar dengan sentimen negatif 38%.

description.en: Lead with verifiable program facts and outcomes to reduce the space for politicized interpretation.
description.id: Utamakan fakta dan hasil program yang dapat diverifikasi untuk mengurangi ruang interpretasi politis.

evidence.en: Political Framing appears in 3% of usable comments with 19% negative sentiment.
evidence.id: Framing Politik muncul di 3% komentar dengan sentimen negatif 19%.

description.en: Address logistics issues such as delays and process complexity, and report on improvements.
description.id: Tangani masalah logistik seperti keterlambatan dan kerumitan proses, lalu laporkan perbaikannya.

evidence.en: Implementation Quality appears in 3% of usable comments with 17% negative sentiment.
evidence.id: Kualitas Pelaksanaan muncul di 3% komentar dengan sentimen negatif 17%.

limitations.en: Results are based on the available Kaggle dataset and may not represent all TikTok users or the wider public.
limitations.id: Hasil didasarkan pada dataset Kaggle yang tersedia dan mungkin tidak mewakili seluruh pengguna TikTok atau masyarakat luas.

limitations.en: Sentiment and issue labels depend on weak labeling and a rule-based taxonomy rather than human-reviewed annotations.
limitations.id: Label sentimen dan isu bergantung pada weak labeling dan taksonomi berbasis aturan, bukan anotasi yang ditinjau manusia.

limitations.en: Risk scoring is an indicator for manual review, not a truth judgment.
limitations.id: Skor risiko adalah indikator untuk peninjauan manual, bukan penilaian benar atau salah.
